sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has been detained behind the bars sicne last 191 days and he shall face the trial, if released.
Considering the nature of allegations, levelled against the present petitioner and considering the nature of offence involved in this case, scanned copy of LCR was called for.

However, considering the fact that on perusal of the scanned copy of the case record, which has been produced in this case,
it appears that it is updated only upto 07.11.2023 on which the examination of the victim girl was fixed before the learned Trial Court.
However, there is no material before this Court to let this Court know as to what happened on that day.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has also not been able to inform this Court as to what happened on that day.
Therefore, let a report be called for from the Court of learned Sessions, Morigaon as regards the latest status report of the Sessions Case No. 127/2023 fixing 01.12.2023 for the status report.
The prayer for bail of the present petitioner shall be considered on the next date on receipt of the status report from the learned Sessions Court, Morigaon.
